lines.quote: Designed and maintained a Python-based processing pipeline for mission telemetry data, handling ingestion, reformatting, and quality-assessment checks.
Written to production engineering standards with version control, code review, and documented APIs.

requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: Role is explicitly described as ground-segment work (data processing tools, simulation infrastructure, mission-planning software) rather than work on the flown instrument itself; no experience with a satellite or aircraft platform's onboard systems is described.

lines.quote: I have held a Finnish residence permit with EU work authorisation since 2006, so there would be no administrative complications on that front.
Participation required Finnish residence-permit holder status with EU work authorisation
All engineering documentation and internal communication conducted in English since 2010, when the company moved to English as its working language for international programmes
I am writing because I have been looking for an opportunity to move to Oulu permanently, and the Senior Signal Processing Engineer posting at Kaikuvaara seemed worth making the case for.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe any experience you have writing production embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware, if any?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement, if any?
